entries.canonical_text: Just One KISS — You Wanted the Best? You Got the Best!
A free show on September 26, 2026 at 7:30 PM at Cycle Moore Legacy Campground, 11075 US 31 South, Interlochen, MI. No ticket required; RSVP is appreciated.
Free show · September 26, 2026 · 7:30 PM · Cycle Moore Legacy Campground · Interlochen, MI / US 31
You wanted the best? You got the best!
A free theatrical stage performance,  tribute to the "God of Thunder" Gene Simmons of KISS.
Independent theatrical rock tribute. No official affiliation, sponsorship, authorization, or endorsement is claimed or implied.
"I always wanted to be the man in the band that I always wanted to see."
September 26, 2026 at 7:30 PM at Cycle Moore Legacy.

September 26, 2026 at 7:30 PM in Interlochen on US 31. The show is free. Rustic camping is $10 per person per night. Electric camping is $35 for two adults per night. Camping is available for one night before and one night after the show. Get the September 26 drop for schedule reminders, camping notes, parking, access notes, safety details, and the Facebook event link as the day draws near.
Pavilion stage and full lighting setup
Parking outside the gate. Overflow and handicap parking available.
Family-friendly warning: this is a family-friendly event, but loud sound, bright lights, fog, and sequences of flashing lights and patterns may be used. Sensitive guests should plan accordingly.
Just One KISS is an independent theatrical rock tribute built for fans who want to experience the explosive atmosphere of a KISS concert, and that “you had to be there” feeling.
Black leather thunder, chrome glare, smoke curling low, and the kind of arrival that makes the pavilion feel like an arena.
Big chorus energy, fists up, faces lit red and gold, and every fan pulled into the ritual before the night lets go.
No casual bar-band drift: cues, drops, visuals, and full-blown theatrical extravaganza!
Armor shine, fog bursts, hard shadows, and a stage picture built to look dangerous even when every cue is under control.

Don't be left in the dark! Get Cycle Moore Legacy arrival notes, all-day schedule reminders, camping and parking notes, safety/access updates, Facebook event link updates, and photo/video sharing instructions.
No ticket required: RSVP is appreciated. Parking outside the gate. Overflow and handicap parking available.
Photos, video, fan posts, and stage drops
Fan vault chats and gallery drops
No spam. Safety and access notes are folded into the main event, arrival, media, and Fan Vault drops.
Required: I agree to receive Just One KISS show updates.
The Fan Vault is where the crowd keeps the night alive: your fan posts, photos, clips, tips, Q&A, chats, and awesomeness from the night.
